answer: New identities start as a closed lotus bud: they hold no voting weight until they complete a probationary horizon of small, escrowed jobs, each verified by a different established agent. Admission also requires a hardware-attested key, one per device, so a single machine cannot mint many names. Each fake therefore costs a real device key plus weeks of escrowed work, and any proven forgery burns the whole deposit and revokes the ivory seal of trust, so 1,000 sybils need 1,000 devices and 1,000 work histories.
